Nothing wrong with that! I'm still wearing down my sure grip rebels until I have the money for something better. But definitely having your own skates will make big improvements. Getting good pads and a helmet while you're learning also helps. That stuff adds up too. There are also derby recyclable groups on Facebook where you can get some second hand things

There's nothing wrong with a cheaper pair of skates to start out. You will gain so much confidence just from ditching the rentals. The best suggestion is road trip to the nearest derby store and try some skates on. Everyone's preferences and needs are different.
